snippet.title: Amiga Longplay Entity
snippet.description:
http://www.recordedamigagames.org

Played by: Ironclaw

I started out a bit noobish as it was the first time I played the game and I didn't even know you lost energy from jumping, so later when I found out, I was a bit more careful.

I started out trying to collect all stuff and show all those hint parchments, and around the last two levels I got tired of it and just wanted to finish the rest of the game, so I skipped some stuff.

The tune on level 2 suuuucks.

Whoops, forgot to edit out the loading in some places, a long one like here: 49:20-49:48 :P -
Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
